# Functional status -- generated by `tools/functional_dashboard.py --write`

DO NOT HAND-EDIT.  Every verdict here is *derived* from the canonical sources listed in
`spec/functional/README.md`; this directory is annotation, never a second ledger.  The run
that produced this file compiled nothing and ran no gate: numbers come from committed
snapshots (`spec/census/*.json`, `spec/INVENTORY.txt`) and from IMPORTING the gate module.
`UNKNOWN` is a legal verdict and is never rendered as success.

## View A -- capabilities

`Rows verdict (mine)` aggregates the MINE status of the cited COVERAGE rows (README law:
PARTIAL when cited rows disagree, UNKNOWN when they carry no verdict).  The `Derived stage
ladder` names the HIGHEST stage any single evidence name of that capability is licensed to
reach -- it is a breadth signal, not a per-shape guarantee; individual shapes stop earlier
and the boundary column says where.  A generic refusal licenses no stage.

## View B -- evidence map

- capability rows: **30** (validated: every cited COVERAGE id exists, every cited census name is one of the 44)
- citation misses: **none**
- duplicate capability ids: **none**
- COVERAGE rows cited by NO capability: **26** -- listed for the operator, never silently dropped:
  - `COND.FIXED_CMP_COLLAPSE_BOTH_TEMPLATES` (COND: `if rec.na = 'ABC' then` and `if 'ABC' = rec.na then`, both with `^=` too, against `2 na char(3)` -- a fixed compare whose literal length EQUALS the declared extent, in BOTH literal templates, TEST position)
  - `COND.FIXED_CMP_EQUAL_EXTENT_COLLAPSE` (COND: `if rec.na = rec.nb then` against `2 na char(3)` / `2 nb char(3)` -- a fixed compare whose two EXTENTS are equal)
  - `COND.FIXED_CMP_OVER_EXTENT` (COND: `if rec.name = 'ABCD' then` against `2 name char(3)` -- a literal LONGER than the FIXED member's declared extent, member-LEFT)
  - `COND.FIXED_CMP_OVER_EXTENT_LITERAL_LEFT` (COND: `if 'ABCD' = rec.na then` and `if 'ABCD' ^= rec.na then` against `2 na char(3)` -- a literal LONGER than the declared extent written LEFT, TEST position)
  - `COND.FIXED_CMP_QUALIFICATION_INVISIBLE` (COND: `if na = rec.nb`, `if rec.na = nb`, `if na = nb` and `if 'AB' = na` -- the BARE (unqualified) spelling of an internal FIXED record member in `?SCCCM` compares, TEST position)
  - `COND.ON_ERROR` (COND: on error ...)
  - `COND.POINTER_EQ` (COND: `if nx = addr(z) then' -- equality between a pointer-valued expression and addr())
  - `DECL.NOT_STATIC_DIAGNOSTIC` (DECL: a member `INITIAL' whose level and every enclosing level name NO storage class)
  - `DECL.RECURSIVE` (DECL: RECURSIVE on a procedure)
  - `DECL.RETURN_VARYING` (DECL: returns(char(n) varying) on an external)
  - `EXPR.ADD_PRESERVE_ROUTE` (EXPR: a+b and a+b+c on FIXED BINARY: which instruction preserves the left operand of an ADD; and which operand is evaluated first when the right one is parenthesized)
  - `EXPR.ELIDE_ZERO_CLASS` (EXPR: x = x + 0)
  - `EXPR.K_PLUS_X` (EXPR: k + x as a store value)
  - `FILE.PUT_LINE` (FILE: put file(f) line(n);)
  - `FILE.PUT_PAGE` (FILE: put file(f) page;)
  - `FILE.PUT_POSITION` (FILE: put file(f) after(n) list(..);  /  put file(f) before(n) list(..))
  - `IO.PUT_BIT1_FILE_ITEM` (IO: `put file(outf) list(<bit1 variable>, <literal>)` -- a BIT(1) item behind a file attach)
  - `IO.PUT_BIT1_ITEM` (IO: `put list(<bit1 variable>)' on the console)
  - `IO.PUT_BIT1_NONFINAL_ITEM` (IO: `put list(<bit1>, '<literal>', ...)` -- a BIT(1) console item in a NON-FINAL position)
  - `LEX.IDENT_SOFTKWD` (LEX: end as an identifier)
  - `LEX.SOURCE_FORM` (LEX: CRLF, ^Z, 8.3 names)
  - `NEG.MEMBER_USE_PERIMETER` (NEG: unauthorized uses of an internal CHARACTER member: line = 'AB'; rec.line = 'AB' on char(14); if line = 'AB'; put edit(line)(a(14)); s = line; nxt = line; s = line || 'X'; s = substr(line,1,3); put list(line, nxt); put file(f) list(line); addr(line); two owners named line; a STATIC head's member; if line; get edit (line) (a))
  - `PROC.LOCAL_FILE` (PROC: FILE declared inside a procedure)
  - `STOR.CHAR_STATIC_STORE` (STOR: `s = '<literal>'` where `s` is `CHARACTER(n) STATIC` or `CHARACTER(n) VARYING STATIC`)
  - `STOR.NULL_STORE` (STOR: p = null())
  - `STOR.STATIC_MEMBER_INITIAL` (STOR: 1 t static, 2 m fixed initial(0))
